rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.quote: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.summary: Annual rent increases are capped at the lower of 3% or 80% of CPI; if CPI is negative, no increase is allowed.
rules.effective_date_evidence: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
rules.coverage_text: The rent cap does not apply to residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or to mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.exemption_note: Mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990 are exempt.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.summary: After 30 days of tenancy, landlords can only terminate a tenancy for just cause stated in a written notice.
rules.effective_date_evidence: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
rules.coverage_text: The Just Cause Ordinance shall not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.exemption_note: Deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels, hospitals, care facilities, dormitories, and shared living quarters are exempt.

rules.title: Santa Ana No-Fault Eviction Relocation Assistance
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.summary: For no-fault evictions, landlords must provide either three months of relocation assistance or waive the final three months of rent.
rules.effective_date_evidence: The new ordinances are not effective until November 19, 2021.
rules.coverage_text: The Just Cause Ordinance shall not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.
rules.exemption_note: Deed-restricted affordable housing, hotels, hospitals, care facilities, dormitories, and shared living quarters are exempt.
